description: This file defines a MockRepository class that provides mock data and simple persistence for a fitness app, including profile management, workout data, badges, search functionality, and progress entries.

classes.name: MockRepository
classes.description: A mock repository class that simulates data storage and retrieval for a fitness app, including profile info, workout lists, badges, and progress data.

methods.name: getProfile
methods.description: Returns the current user profile, using data stored in SharedPreferences or default values.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates the user's profile information in SharedPreferences and updates the stored goal data.

methods.name: updateGoal
methods.description: Updates the user's goal data in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getRecommended
methods.description: Generates a list of recommended workouts based on user profile and preferences.

methods.name: getBadges
methods.description: Returns a list of available badges.

methods.name: getWorkouts
methods.description: Returns the full list of workouts.

methods.name: searchWorkouts
methods.description: Searches workouts by query matching title, category, or intensity.

methods.name: recentProgress
methods.description: Generates mock recent progress data for the past 7 days.
